// Test fixture of tools/hms statemachines rule 12 (copied to <project>/src/test/kotlin as ToyLightGuardsTest.kt).
// NOT FOR CLINICAL USE. Every predicate is named in a test name; the comment "lampIntact" does not count.
package hms.adt.domain.toylight

import io.kotest.core.spec.style.FunSpec
import io.kotest.matchers.shouldBe

class ToyLightGuardsTest :
    FunSpec({
        val off = ToyLightFacts(mainsOn = false, generatorOn = false, inspectionPassed = false, privileged = false, audited = false)

        test("powerAvailable holds on mains power") {
            ToyLightGuards.powerAvailable(off.copy(mainsOn = true)) shouldBe true
        }

        context("lampIntact") {
            test("holds after a passed inspection") { ToyLightGuards.lampIntact(off.copy(inspectionPassed = true)) shouldBe true }
            test("does not hold without one") { ToyLightGuards.lampIntact(off) shouldBe false }
        }

        test("privilegedAndAudited needs ${"both"} the privilege and the audit") {
            ToyLightGuards.privilegedAndAudited(off.copy(privileged = true)) shouldBe false
        }
    })
